title: Ollama Native Installation
description: Native install keeps model I/O off the Docker path; download and verify models via curl.

steps.description: Native install: the script installs Ollama directly on the host.
Pulling models: qwen2.5:3b, llama3, and hermes3:8b are downloaded for inference.
Verification: curl to localhost:11434/api/tags lists the installed models.
